question:
Fill in the blank with the correct homophone:

She wanted _________ join the hiking trip too, as the mountains held a special place in her heart.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"to"** is a preposition used to indicate direction, place, or position. (की ओर)

 
 
• **Example: **She wanted **to** join the hiking trip too, as the mountains held a special place in her heart.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **toon** (कार्टून): This refers to a cartoon or animated character.

 
 
• **Example: **The kids love watching the toon characters on TV.
 
 
 
• **two** (दो): This is the number 2.
 
 
• **Example: **She bought two tickets for the movie.
 
 
 
• The word **"too" **means also or in addition; it is used to show that a second thing is included or happens in the same way as the first. (भी)
 
 
• Example: She wanted to come** too,** but she had other plans.
